text: Joe is the consummate professional.  He is punctual and communicates well with the client.  I had a sizable puncture in my roof from an oak's limb.  He scheduled the work within my time frame, let me know when the crew would arrive and did an excellent job repairing the hole and did a thorough job of cleanup.  From quote to completion his rates are very competitve.  Joe is a very affable and honest chap.  He truly cares about his clients and fully understands the importance of word of mouth.  I highly recommend Magnolia for any roof related projects.

name: Gina Horton
text: we needed a few things on our roof fixed after our home owners inspection came back. our closing day was quickly approaching and we needed the fixes done asap for our buyers. I reached out to magnolia roofing company, sent them our inspection report and they were out there within days. professional and reliable, these guys are amazing! thanks joe for taking care of our roof! Highly recommend these guys!

name: Obinna Ekechukwu
text: Joe was very prompt in taking a look at my leaking roof. He was able to quickly fix the problem at a very affordable price. Thank you for being professional, prompt, and responsive!

name: Michael S
text: Magnolia replaced our entire roof due to some damage from wind as well as its overall age. Joe and Daniel were very responsive and helpful through the whole process and especially dealing with the insurance company. Daniel met the insurance adjuster at our house to point out the damage as well as answer any questions he might have had. The roof replacement crew showed up on time and handled the tear-off, replacement, and cleanup all in a very efficient manner in a single day. We upgraded from the standard 3-tab to architectural shingles and it looks so much nicer now because of that change. I recommend these folks for any roofing repair or replacement you might need!

name: Cat C
text: My new roof needed repairs and they did a wonderful job! Very nice people to work with. Highly recommend!

name: Pat Andrews
text: Good professional service..

name: Lacy Bland
text: Had the pleasure of working with Joe. He was extremely helpful and walked us through the entire roof replacement process. The prices are reasonable, the customer service is excellent, and the new roof looks great! Would definitely recommend!

name: Brian Gambrell
text: Magnolia did a fantastic job fixing the mistake of another roofing company plus add new covered gutters to our house. They were on time and on budget. Couldn’t ask for better service. They are now the first people I call when I need work done.

name: Michael Mariani
text: Magnolia Roofing is the real deal!  This is the second time I have used them, and they are professional, fair, and hard workers.  They completed the install on time and with in budget.  Thank you, look forward to using you guys again.

text: This team did such a great job! Worked hard to get the roof done in one day. I didn’t have to lift a finger and the price compared to all the other estimates could not be touched! Also, they cleaned up so good you couldn’t tell they had even been at my house except for the beautiful new roof!

name: Aaron Wirth
text: Great company to work with, very honest and prompt.  Much recommend and very easy to work with.

text: Magnolia gave us a new roof this week. Joe and Daniel were awesome to work with and their crew did an amazing job! They were fast and the mess was minimal during the job, and they did a fantastic job cleaning up after. I would absolutely recommend Magnolia Roofing!

text: Very professional and proficient small business that is sure to grow. Magnolia was quick to respond to my initial call and any communications thereafter. text:
Great experience working with Joe and his crew!  It was seamless from meeting to inspect the roof, quote, and scheduling.
The crew doing the job were impressive at how effortless they made it look.
They will definitely be our 1st call on any future needs!

name: Renee Bumgarner Royall
text: Joe and Daniel are extremely honest and hardworking. As a Realtor of 15 years, I've seen many a shady contractor.  That said, Joe and Daniel from Magnolia Roofing & Remodeling LLC are my trustworthy "go-to's" for many issues.  I highly recommend them and trust them with my own home!

name: Julie Martin
text: Joe came out today and looked at an issue I was having with my roof. He explained everything to me and how they could take care of it. He was super friendly, helpful and very timely.

name: Ruth Hornish Poland
text:
I highly recommend using Magnolia Roofing & Remodeling. I bought my house and the roof was a year old, sadly it was not put on by Magnolia Roofing.  When I woke up to rain in my kitchen I called a few people and they were the only roofers who showed up when they said they would. They fixed the leak, for the price I was quoted, around the pipe coming out of the roof and it’s been dry ever since. 

I recently had a leak, from my chimney (different than the first leak) and not only did they caulk it, at no cost, they could have reshingled  the entire area and charged me for it. Even when I asked the price to redo the area I was pleasantly surprised at the low cost.  It’s  so nice to find honest people with a company that stands behind their work.  Thank you Magnolia Roofing & Remodeling!

name: Lynn Odom
text: Magnolia is the best company we have dealt with in a longtime. Joe and his crew do an excellent job with integrity from beginning to end. Their prices are more than fair. text: Joe handled the new roofing process from start to finish.  He offered fair prices and great service.  His crew, which he stayed with most of the day, was outstanding.  They had 5,200sf to do, came early and stayed late to finish in one day.  Complements to Magnolia; I highly  recommend them.

text: Joe and his team are the best!!! It’s hard to find honest companies and he by far was the most honest I’ve encountered!! Will definitely be using him and his team again!!! Thanks Joe!!!

text: Joe and his crew did an awesome job repairing my Sheetrock at my office. We had some plumbing issues, so the wall had to be opened up. They completed the job on time as promised, and cleaned up the mess.

name: Joseph Vaughn
text: These guys do excellent work. Had a full roof upgrade. They removed the entire old roof, replaced some dated wood and other parts under the shingles, and installed a brand new roof with great red-brown colored shingles. The guys are professional, experienced, and super helpful. No complaints at all. And for all they did the price is very reasonable. I highly recommend Magnolia Roofing.

name: Beverly McCullough
text: I can not say enough about Joe and his crew. He stepped into an existing situation and made it all perfect. From small to large Magnolia Roofing will be my first step.  Joe returned every call and text, he followed through with everything that he promised. I am beyond thrilled with the finished product.

name: Cassandra Avant-Williams
text: Omg!!  Hire these guys!! They are professional, friendly, fun, honest, affordable and completed the work in a timely manner. I was referred to them today and within a couple of hours they came out and completed the work. I need shingles replaced and they went the extra mile as to check the entire roof to ensure nothing else was wrong with it. Afterwards, they got to work!! They were here before the schedule time and kept me informed throughout the process. They are my go to guys! Seriously!! Thanks Joe and Daniel for the service, and communication. I’ll see you guys soon for the next project!

text: As a realtor in Columbia, Magnolia has helped many of our clients with excellent service and results.  Joe and Daniel are very responsive and experienced. text: The crew did a great job handling my roof. It may have been a small job for them but it was a big deal for us!
